how_to_play: How to play: Collect all jimpitan coins while avoiding ghosts!
story_page_1:
Welcome to Ronda Patrol!

In Indonesia, there is a tradition called 'ronda' — a form of community self-reliance in maintaining neighborhood security. This culture is still alive in many villages and some housing complexes in big cities. Although its frequency has decreased in urban areas due to busy lifestyles, the spirit of mutual cooperation (gotong royong) that lies at the heart of this tradition remains strong. Enjoy the adventure of protecting your neighborhood while experiencing the tense atmosphere of the night world.
story_page_2: Ronda activities are often associated with the jimpitan tradition — setting aside coins at the house gate as a form of support for those on guard duty. While patrolling from house to house, the ronda officers collect these coins. The collected jimpitan funds are then used to purchase supplies for duty, including food, drinks, batteries for flashlights, and more.
story_page_3:
Food and drinks keep you in shape during your ronda. In this game you can consume:
- {icon_peanut} Peanuts — a must-have snack during ronda. Besides warding off boredom, peanuts effectively fill your stomach so you stay focused.
- {icon_cassava} Cassava — a legendary Indonesian snack. Very filling and an effective solution when your stomach starts growling in the middle of the night.
- {icon_coffee} Coffee — the most loyal companion drink. Coffee provides instant refreshment that keeps you awake and alert throughout the night.
story_page_4:
Collect jimpitan coins!

Be careful when collecting jimpitan coins! Ghosts terrorizing in the darkness of the night are ready to stop you. Avoid their pursuit by any means; if they catch you, their terror will make you pass out and fall ill. Also beware of thieves, who sometimes appear and take the money you have.

- {icon_dpad} Use the directional pad to walk around the village.
story_page_5:
Although the ghosts are frightening, don't worry — you can face them in various ways.
- {icon_flashlight} Use your flashlight to shine on them, they really don't like light.
- {icon_balm} Use balm, you'll gain immunity to their terror for some time.

If you manage to eliminate ghosts, they will drop pesugihan in the form of bonus coins.
story_page_6:
Sajen is an offering or dish intended for spiritual entities. Ghosts really love the sajen presented for them.
- {icon_sajen} Use sajen as a distraction, it will give you some time free from the ghosts' terror.
story_page_7: Don't panic when your supplies and energy run out. Immediately return to the poskamling to restore stamina. Poskamling is the safest place to take shelter during your ronda duty.
story_page_8: Beware of thieves! They can appear at any time and anywhere. Thieves will target you and steal the items you have, or steal money from the treasury. You can use the flashlight to drive away thieves.
story_page_9: Complete your ronda duty. Count the jimpitan you've collected, then prepare for the next night. Stay alert, because tense nights will always await you.
